gas_regression_attribution.conclusion: Representative +3063 metered gas matches ENCODE_TYPE RewardState increase of 1021 bytes at 3 gas/byte. supplemental_verification.procedure: Copy target fixture and metric helper into isolated pinned Gno after setup.py --exclude-tests. Supplement only the copied collectRewardMetric with before/after GetRealmStorageDiffs and sorted per-realm output. Generate golden, reject Error/TypeCheckError directives, then gno test . -v -run . WITHOUT -update-golden-tests. Repeat for both source revisions.
supplemental_verification.supplemental_gas_not_used: Pre-window storage snapshot warms a read and lowers first-window gas by 3144 equally; all fee estimates use the unchanged full standard reports, not smoke gas.
supplemental_verification.per_realm_source: Supplemental snapshots; sums checked against all three standard report storage rows.

limitations: Standard runner uses -update-golden-tests, which can accept runtime panics as golden output. Dedicated new fixture was independently checked without error directives and strictly replayed.
Existing legacy staker collection fixtures emitted no normalized collection rows; they are not counted as coverage of successful collections. New three-window fixture provides that coverage.
CPU cycles are not wall-clock latency.
Only the three sequential measured collections form a cumulative workload, not a complete unstake/withdraw lifecycle.
No merge, deployment, companion contract PR, or workspace submodule pin update.
